interpretation.main_finding: A nominally 2016-published checklist inherits a 2010 eventDate across all distribution records; 13/24 reliably extirpated taxon-island pairs are nevertheless flagged present, including twelve with last record before 2010. 'present' cannot be interpreted as a contemporary living population or a pre-loss t0 donor without source-level historical verification.
interpretation.source_complementarity: The 2010-era list can reveal a documented island-level historical geographic footprint: 18/20 loss-affected taxa have other islands listed present, but contemporary persistence, viability, source status, colonization and rescue are NOT observed.
interpretation.single_vs_repeat: Other-island documented footprint mean is similar between one-loss (3.625) and two-loss (3.75) taxa; no clear positive range-breadth gradient on this tiny, historical, case-only sample. Do not infer no ecological effect from n4 repeated.
interpretation.missings: Unlisted or irregular/rare status is not an observed absence; primary present-only status was frozen before biological rows.
interpretation.risk_set: Historic at-risk species×island complete loss+persist denominator still NOT identified. Published checklist includes past statuses with a nominal 2010 year and varying effort.
interpretation.data_dependencies: 2016 checklist based on Borges 2010 and potentially overlapping source literature with S1; not independent prospective population monitoring.
